target: SWE intern / new-grad roles (general software engineering, 2026–27 recruiting cycle)

score_rationale.impact_clarity: Several bullets end on tech or method (AWS role, PhysTwin, IEX bullets) with no outcome; Amazon contract bullets lead with services over purpose.

score_rationale.credibility: Four concurrent 'Present' roles overlapping a Redmond on-site internship raises questions; two Amazon entries may look double-counted; 'Claude skill' is unclear jargon.
